name: Special Joint City Council & Planning Commission - 4:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special Joint City Council & Planning Commission - 4:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 11, 2019 -
04:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL - City Council:
Mayor Blakespear, Deputy Mayor Hubbard, Council Members Hinze, Kranz and Mosca; Planning Commission: Chair O'Grady, Commissioners Apuzzo, Doyle, Ehlers and Farrow
AGENDA ITEMS
1.
City Council and Planning Commission discussion regarding the Housing Plan Update process to date and associated analysis to achieve a State-certified Housing Element by April 2021. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
Discuss Housing Element Update 2021-2029 findings to date and provide direction to staff as necessary.
2019-12-11 Special Joint Item #1 Housing Element 6th Cycle Update
2.
City Council and Planning Commission review and discussion of the nexus study, gap analysis, and financial feasibility analysis for potential increase in inclusionary housing requirements and in-lieu fee. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
Discuss completed feasibility analysis and nexus studies and provide direction to staff.
2019-12-11 Special Joint Item #2 Inclusionary Housing
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
